title: Affidavit Type Policy Schema
description: Schema for policy_json field in AffidavitType model

system_prompt.description: System prompt for AI drafting. Defines the AI's role and behavior.
system_prompt.example: You are an expert legal document drafter specializing in affidavits for Trinidad and Tobago...

template.description: Template structure showing the expected document format
template.example:
AFFIDAVIT OF [TYPE]

I, [NAME], of [ADDRESS], do solemnly and sincerely declare...

required_sections.description: List of sections that must appear in the final document

required_fields.description: Fields that must be present in user answers

disallowed_phrases.description: Phrases that should NOT appear in the generated draft

validation_rules.description: Custom validation rules for QA checks

example.description: Event date must be in the past

keywords.description: Keywords to match in user answers

keyword_threshold.description: Minimum keywords to match for scenario detection

drafting_instructions.description: Special instructions for drafting this scenario

scenario_library.description: Known scenario patterns for this affidavit type

example.name: Voluntary Job Termination
example.drafting_instructions: Emphasize the voluntary nature of the departure

scenario.description: Scenario tag this example belongs to

output.description: Expected draft output for this input

few_shot_examples.description: Few-shot examples for AI drafting guidance

example.output:
AFFIDAVIT OF UNEMPLOYMENT

I, JOHN SMITH, of [address], do solemnly and sincerely declare as follows:

1. I was previously employed at ABC Company Ltd.
2. My employment ended on the 1st day of December, 2025, when I voluntarily resigned from my position.
3. The reason for my departure was personal in nature.
4. I make this affidavit for the purpose of [purpose].

AND I make this solemn declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true.

intake_questions.description: Intake form questions for this affidavit type

examples.system_prompt: You are an expert legal document drafter specializing in unemployment affidavits for Trinidad and Tobago. Generate formal, legally-sound affidavits that are suitable for commissioning.
examples.template:
AFFIDAVIT OF UNEMPLOYMENT

I, [FULL NAME], of [ADDRESS], do solemnly and sincerely declare as follows:

1. [Employment history]
2. [Termination details]
3. [Current status]
4. [Purpose of affidavit]

AND I make this solemn declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true.

validation_rules.description: Termination date must be in the past

scenario_library.name: Company Layoff
scenario_library.drafting_instructions: Clarify this was not due to misconduct

few_shot_examples.output:
AFFIDAVIT OF UNEMPLOYMENT

I, JANE DOE, do solemnly and sincerely declare:

1. I was employed at XYZ Corp.
2. On November 15, 2025, my employment was terminated due to company restructuring.
3. This termination was not due to any misconduct on my part.

AND I make this solemn declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true.
